p1_b5.ocr: Growth conditions and DNA isolation B. tusciae strain T2T, DSM 2912, was grown in DSMZ medium 369 (Bacillus tusciae medium) [36] at 50°C. DNA was isolated from 1-1.5 g of cell paste using Qiagen Genomic 500 DNA Kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Ger- many) with lysis modification st/LALMP according to Wu et al. [35]. DNA is available through the DNA Bank Network [37].
